cohort: The study included 122 breast milk-fed preterm neonates (initially 132 recruited from 112 mothers) monitored from birth to 38 weeks' postmenstrual age.
finding: Morning serum melatonin in breast milk-fed preterm neonates from 26-38 weeks' PMA exhibited substantial individual variability but no consistent differences based on time of birth, postmenstrual age, or weight-for-gestational-age.
gest_age: preterm neonates (including those <33 weeks' GA and >=33 weeks' GA at birth)
